name: Water Treatment Plant (Site C)
description:
The **most dangerous zombie location** in the game, the *Water Treatment Plant*, also known as *Site C*.

### Threat Level: EXTREME
- Most aggressive zombie spawns in the game
- Highest zombie population density
- Zombies can spawn directly in front of you

### Location
Located under the bridge with an underground sewer system.

### Recommended Strategy
- **Bring a team** - solo runs are nearly impossible
- Shoot zombies in the legs to immobilize and prevent respawns
- Have one teammate lure zombies while another moves in
- Utilise the smaller sewage tunnels shown in the images

*Do not attempt alone.*

name: Metro New York Hospital
description:
The **largest** explorable building on the map.
### Features

* Multiple floors with **extensive loot throughout**
* Rooftop extraction point on the 15th floor
* **Overwhelming zombie presence**

### Entrances

* Northeastern (staircase to the 2nd floor)
* Eastern
* Southeast
* South
* Southwest

### Loot Highlights

* **Abundant loot on every floor except the top**: ammunition, medical supplies, and other essentials
* 15th floor contains **the extraction landing pad** and an enterable room called **15A2**, which mostly has office furniture (chairs, desks, etc.) and **little to no valuable loot**
* Food is limited, but water supplies can be found in the northeastern entrance building
* Gas masks are common, so gas damage is usually not a concern

### Tactics

* Multiple enemy locations around the hospital mean zombies can hear gunfire and rush toward the sound
* **Stealth tips:**

  * Avoid being seen when zombies start running
  * Be patient and use zombie spawn/despawn mechanics to move safely
  * It’s possible to loot the hospital **without killing a single zombie** using careful stealth

### Warning

*Come fully prepared*: ammunition, medical supplies, and a gas mask are essential.*

name: Armory
description:
A locked room on the **lowest floor** of the Military Checkpoint parking garage. Requires the **Armory Key** to open — the key has been reported as **extremely rare or currently unobtainable**.

- End-game weapons (including silenced ARs)
- Ammo of various types
- Military equipment

### Access

name: Military Checkpoint Garage
description:
A multi-floor parking garage and **zombie nest** inside the Military Checkpoint quarantine zone. Expect **20+ zombies per floor** — do not enter the nest at night.

### Layout
- **Top floor**: Main entrance, back office room with cabinets and folders
- **First lower floor**: Civilian cars, regular loot (expired food, civilian tools)
- **Lowest floor**: Military gear, ammo, weapons, cosmetics — and the **Armory** locked room

### Access Points
- Main entrance (top floor)
- Alternative stairwell entrance
- Large driveway ramp connecting floors

### Warning
Zombie numbers are extreme, especially at night. *Daytime entry strongly recommended.*

images.description: Main entrance of the parking lot
Office room on the top floor

name: Military Checkpoint
description:
One of the most **resource-rich quarantine zones** on the map, centered around a military checkpoint and a multi-floor parking garage zombie nest.

### Loot Highlights
- Medical items
- **M249** and other high-tier weapons
- Ammo of all types
- Military cosmetic gear
- The **Armory** (locked, key extremely rare) on the lowest garage floor

### Threats
- **High military zombie density** throughout the zone
- The parking garage zombie nest can spawn **20+ zombies per floor**
- Night time significantly increases spawn rates — avoid the nest after dark

### Recommended Entry
Use the **back entrance** next to the basketball field to avoid the main checkpoint concentration of zombies.
